entries.name: Sunder Strike
entries.description: Strike an adjacent foe with weapon damage +2 and inflict Sundered (-2 defense for 6 turns).

entries.name: Iron Cleave
entries.description: Sweep all adjacent foes with your weapon.

entries.name: Executioner's Vow
entries.description: Passive: against foes below half health, gain +5% crit and +2 damage per rank.

entries.name: Vanguard Charge
entries.description: Rush beside a visible foe within 4 tiles, strike for weapon +2, and knock them back 1 tile (+3 & Sundered on wall slam).

entries.name: Shield Brace
entries.description: Anchor your guard: gain Braced (+3 defense, +1 evasion, +15% physical resist) for 5 turns.

entries.name: Tempered Plate
entries.description: Passive: +1 defense per rank, and Iron Oath triggers below 65% health.

entries.name: Unyielding March
entries.description: Mend 6 + Might health and gain Braced for 5 turns.

entries.name: Break the Chain
entries.description: Shatter Isolation, Monopolized Sight, and Bleeding, and gain Apostate Focus for 5 turns.

entries.name: Ward Breaker
entries.description: Passive: +2 damage per rank against Dominion foes and guardians.

entries.name: Defiant Decree
entries.description: Deal 4 + Might/2 Radiant damage to visible foes within 3 tiles and inflict Sundered.

entries.name: Quick Shift
entries.description: Passive: switching Masks takes half a turn, and Bare Face cools +1 extra risk per rank.

entries.name: Veil Step
entries.description: Phase to a visible open tile within 4 tiles, freeing Pinned and cooling 1 Mask risk (Veiled in Nyx).

entries.name: Sovereign Vent
entries.description: Spend accumulated Mask risk to blast visible foes within 3 tiles for 4 + risk/2 + Will Void/Fire/Radiant damage.

entries.name: Crowned Frequency
entries.description: Passive: +2 max Mask risk threshold per rank, and +1 to your active Mask's primary stat per rank.

entries.name: Gaze of Lilith
entries.description: Strike a visible foe within 5 tiles for 3 + Will Void damage (5 + Will in Lilith) and clear fog.

entries.name: Clear Witness
entries.description: Passive: +1 sight and +1 accuracy per rank; halves Monopolized Sight duration.

entries.name: Unmake Record
entries.description: Deal 5 + Will Void damage to a visible foe within 5 tiles and inflict Sundered.

entries.name: Siphon Surge
entries.description: Drain 3 + Will Void health from a visible foe within 4 tiles, healing for half.

entries.name: Alchemical Restraint
entries.description: Passive: Soul Siphon heals +1 per rank and Reckoning fades 8 turns sooner per rank.

entries.name: Transmute Pain
entries.description: Clear Reckoning, Isolation, Dissolution, and Exposure, and heal 6 + Will health.

entries.name: Fade to Ash
entries.description: Gain Veiled (+4 evasion for 4 turns) and drop pursuit of awake foes outside melee.

entries.name: Unseen Edge
entries.description: Passive: +2 sneak attack damage per rank and foes notice 15% less easily per rank.

entries.name: Shadow Step
entries.description: Slip beside a visible foe within 4 tiles and strike unaware if they were not adjacent.

entries.name: Arterial Cut
entries.description: Strike an adjacent foe and inflict Bleeding (2 damage per turn for 5 turns).

entries.name: Keen Blade
entries.description: Passive: +6% crit chance and +1 accuracy per rank.

entries.name: Coup de Grace
entries.description: Guaranteed critical hit on an adjacent foe (+4 bonus damage if bleeding or sundered).

entries.name: Crippling Shot
entries.description: Shoot a visible foe within 6 tiles for ranged damage +2 and inflict Chilled (or Pinned if unaware).

entries.name: Backstep
entries.description: Spring 2 tiles away from the nearest adjacent foe and gain Veiled for 2 turns.

entries.name: Fleet Foot
entries.description: Passive: +5 speed and +1 evasion per rank.

entries.name: Flurry
entries.description: Make two rapid weapon strikes against an adjacent foe.
